mapper.sql: id, event_id AS eventId, tenant_id AS tenantId, course_id AS courseId, notification_type AS notificationType, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, event_key AS eventKey, actor_user_id AS actorUserId, message, deep_link AS deepLink, occurred_at AS occurredAt, recipient_mode AS recipientMode, template_vars_json AS templateVarsJson, status, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, lease_until AS leaseUntil, claim_token AS claimToken, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM notification_event_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', 'PROCESSING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
